front.source_observation: Northeast overview: high frame with inward-sloping top return, deep east galleries, 5 south and 2 north sloped balconies plus lower terrace, open court, front raised glazing band and asymmetric northern lower entry retained.

rear.source_observation: Southwest rear overview: conservative unfenestrated west classroom mass and differing end cores retained; the previous display-only diagonal color artifacts are absent. Does not assert true western facade has no windows.

east.source_observation: Full east elevation: 5/2 asymmetric balcony cadence, sloping giant frame, raised front recessed long glazing, southern stair niche and northern upper screen/lower entry visible. Passage behind leftmost front bay retained despite the southern rear low-wing wall visible beyond.

west.source_observation: Full west elevation openly exposes the intentionally simplified back and limited ground through-passages; no invented copied east windows or undated equipment.

south.source_observation: Full south short side remains conservative where source views are tree-obscured; different south core and low wing are not mirrored from north. Visible rounded top-frame termination is a disclosed manufacture join, not a surveyed facade fitting.

north.source_observation: Full north short side shows tall narrow slot with floor-edge crossings, different deeper northern core, and front low wing; occluded rear detail remains plain. Rounded terminal top-frame join is a manufacture simplification.

top.source_observation: Top view preserves high-strip roof, unequal end cores, deep front frame return, southern and northern low wings and open-to-sky central court. The simple roof intentionally excludes undated PV/equipment and is not a surveyed roof plan.

courtyard-gallery.source_observation: Deliberate perspective detail of inner east gallery: corridor depth, real openings, thickened guard bands, columns, rear recessed opaque glazing and offset sloping balconies remain legible. No near-plane clipping or false fill across the courtyard; steps, fine rails and lettering omitted.

courtyard-arcade.source_observation: Deliberate inner-court perspective verifies raised front corridor, thickened columns, open passage under it and northern upper screen/entry distinction. Court remains open and unfilled; pool, bridge, fine steps and landscaping are intentionally omitted.
